notes.title: 📍 Leaf Blower Co. Demo Major Update - Based on Your Feedback
notes.content: [h2]🌱 Hey there! Your feedback has helped us make Leaf Blower Co. even better! [/h2][p][/p][p]As you might have seen in our previous post, we are heading to Cologne for [b]Gamescom 2025[/b]. The event runs from [b]20 to 24 August[/b] and if you are also attending, you can come meet us in person.[/p][p]We will be at [b]The Indie Arena Booth[/b] where you can try out Forklift games, chat with the team, pick up exclusive giveaways and snap some fun photos with us. We will be there in full leaf blowing spirit and would love to meet you.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621723/701ae711b27646b73e20922e022403b2540b43ab.png"][/img][/p][p]But there is more. Steam is already featuring all Gamescom participants today and to celebrate we have updated the [b]Leaf Blower Co. Demo[/b]. This update is based directly on your feedback and we are incredibly grateful for all the suggestions, bug reports and ideas you have shared. They have helped us make the game even better for everyone. Thank you![/p][p][/p][p]And as special treat, we've even switched out one of the Freeplay levels - jump into the calming zen of the new Japanese Courtyard location now![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3720140/Leaf_Blower_Co_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3][b]🆕 New Content and Features[/b][/h3][list][*][p]New job selection board: all jobs are now represented as postcards on a map, including bonus jobs[/p][/*][*][p]Mushrooms added (similar to weeds) to burn on ground and trees[/p][/*][*][p]New level unlocked after first area cleared (not seen before in the demo)[/p][/*][*][p]New "No Zones Mode" Prototype available in HUB — play without zones[/p][/*][*][p]Bonus Work now has random weather and time[/p][/*][*][p]Air now blows along the ground instead of just at leaves which are pointed at directly[/p][/*][*][p]New butterflies added to the Mayor’s house[/p][/*][*][p]Clean wipes happen in each zone for every 25% of total leaves collected in that zone[/p][/*][/list][p][b]🎮 Gameplay Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]XP now earned twice as fast[/p][/*][*][p]Leaves are randomly dispersed on each level every time you play[/p][/*][*][p]Crows are random across all levels they’re in[/p][/*][*][p]Weeds are random across all levels they’re in[/p][/*][*][p]Leaves will not get kicked forward in first person mode but will in 3rd person mode[/p][/*][*][p]Tarp bag stacking improved[/p][/*][*][p]Bins now have a cluster mode that counts leaves blown into them continuously until 3 seconds have elapsed without any getting blown in, then displays and awards points[/p][/*][*][p]Bins count down the number of leaves remaining[/p][/*][*][p]Ground Circle on for Shredder, off for Leafblower (default setting)[/p][/*][/list][p][b]🎨 Visuals and UI[/b][/p][list][*][p]New animations and floor wipes for cleared areas (every 25% cleared) with on-screen indication[/p][/*][*][p]UI updates to show progression[/p][/*][*][p]Ground circle indicator off by default, can be enabled in Settings → General[/p][/*][*][p]FOV now available as an option in Settings[/p][/*][*][p]The TAB key now toggles the HUD on and off[/p][/*][*][p]Cursor reverted to standard cursor to avoid input lag issue on menus[/p][/*][*][p]Emissive leaves always off even at night[/p][/*][/list][p][b]🔊 Audio[/b][/p][list][*][p]Lots of sounds removed for a more zen experience[/p][/*][/list][p][b]🏠 World Interactions[/b][/p][list][*][p]Shower can now be turned off in Mayor's house[/p][/*][/list][p][b]💡 Quality of Life[/b][/p][list][*][p]Update to pop-up tips[/p][/*][*][p]Random jobs no longer set in pitch dark (can still be called from freeplay)[/p][/*][/list][p][b]🐞 Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Snow no longer collects on pipes so numbers can always be seen clearly regardless of weather[/p][/*][*][p]Coconuts no longer play audio for too long when under water[/p][/*][*][p]Boxes in suburb fixed so they no longer disappear[/p][/*][*][p]POV bug fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Weeds and crow counts fixed so they match the objectives[/p][/*][*][p]Mushroom counts fixed on the side underneath the level indicator[/p][/*][*][p]Bug with "mushroom taken care of" text on the UI causing the level radial wheel to be the wrong size is now fixed[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][i]— The Leaf Blower Team[/i][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/vpqqamaEbJ" style="button"]JOIN OUR DISCORD[/url][/p]

notes.title: 🍃 Leaf Blower Co. joins the Wholesome Games Celebration
notes.content: [h1]Let’s blow in some good news 🍃[/h1][p][/p][p]We have a few lovely things to share today. From festivals to real-life meetups to what is coming next for Leaf Blower Co., there is a lot to celebrate and we would love to have you with us.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]🌿 Part of [/b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/wholesomegames"]The Wholesome Games Celebration[/url][/h2][p]Starting today, Leaf Blower Co. is featured in [i]The Wholesome Games Celebration[/i], a cozy global event that highlights games full of hope, joy, and introspection. We are really happy to be included.[/p][p]If Leaf Blower Co. has ever made you smile, now is the perfect time to celebrate with us. Blow some leaves, support some wholesome games, and enjoy the good vibes![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621723/51be9b254dbb6136fd38f07eb158c57ebddfd08f.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]📍 Meet us at Gamescom 2025[/b][/h2][p]We’re heading to Cologne for Gamescom 2025 and we’d love to see you there.[/p][h3]20–24 August | [url="https://indiearenabooth.de/gamescom2025/games"]The Indie Arena Booth[/url][/h3][p]Stop by to try out Forklift games, chat with the team, pick up exclusive giveaways, and take some fun photos with us. We will be there in full leaf-blowing spirit and would love to meet you![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621723/701ae711b27646b73e20922e022403b2540b43ab.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]🍁 [b]Now part of the Steam Debut Festival[/b][/h2][p]We are also taking part in the [i]Debut Festival[/i] on Steam, a celebration of new games from first-time studios. It is a joy to be featured alongside so many fresh and creative projects![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621723/bcdde197b3e731050114f3e7dd084b442382c876.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for supporting us, for trying the demo, and for being part of the beginning of Leaf Blower Co.[/p][p]We are currently working on a [b]big update to the demo[/b], and we cannot wait to share more. Stay tuned so you do not miss what is coming next![/p][p][/p][p][i]— The Leaf Blower Team[/i][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/vpqqamaEbJ" style="button"]JOIN OUR DISCORD[/url][/p]

notes.title: 🍂 Big Demo Refresh inspired by your feedback!
notes.content: [h1]Hello Leaf Blowers![/h1][p]First of all, thank you so much for all your support! Your reviews, feedback in the Steam forums, and comments on our [url="https://discord.gg/VwsJQW3WWu"]Discord [/url]have been incredibly helpful. And of course, each and every survey response has been invaluble. This update wouldn’t be the same without your input. [/p][p]If you haven’t [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3720140/#app_reviews_hash"]left a review[/url] yet, we’d really appreciate it. It helps us a lot![/p][p]We’ve just released a big update for the [i]Leaf Blower Co. Demo[/i], packed with UI upgrades, improved scanning, smarter leaf logic, and a bunch of quality-of-life improvements.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3720140/Leaf_Blower_Co_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h2]🍃 Here’s what’s new:[/h2][p][/p][p][b]🧰 UI & Tools Makeover[/b][/p][list][*][p]The Tool Wheel, Nozzle Wheel, and Skills Wheel have all been refreshed[/p][/*][*][p]Cleaner, sharper HUD visuals[/p][/*][*][p]Hint icons now use crisp button images[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]🗺️ Mini-map & Scan Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]When you’re down to the last 25 leaves, they’ll now appear at the edge of the mini-map if they’re out of view[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621723/6f97e7df352056278ba7ee6b233d28c719ea9492.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Scan markers now use waypoint-style icons that are visible through walls[/p][/*][*][p]Bags and weeds are now included in scans[/p][/*][*][p]New situational waypoints, so things like tarps and chargers now have intuitive icons[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]🍃 Leaf Overhauls[/b][/p][list][*][p]The Roman Park now uses three simplified leaf sets, one per stage, to help prevent stuck leaves[/p][/*][*][p]The Mansion now features a single set of 2500 leaves, removing invisible barriers and offering more freedom[/p][/*][*][p]We’ve tested and confirmed support for 2000 leaves on screen at once[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621723/129c0c9ca027db3fb501f069ff52fae170dd41af.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]📦 Hub & Helpers[/b][/p][list][*][p]Physics for boxes in the hub have been improved[/p][/*][*][p]Crows have new idle animations to make them easier to spot[/p][/*][*][p]The "Help, I’ve got a stuck leaf" tool now finds up to 10 leaves and works even through walls[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]🧹 Moveable Bin Update[/b][/p][list][*][p]You can now place the moveable bin anywhere that doesn’t contain leaves[/p][/*][*][p]If you try to place it on leaves, a visual warning will appear[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621723/bee46ebc2c986823954bdcfcb7723c765dedc77d.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]This replaces the older system that blocked placement in active play zones[/p][/*][/list][p][b]🪲 Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Pressing 1 or 2 no longer forces a tool swap if that tool is already equipped[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the bin could be taken up the ladder[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621723/7310c16f4a94b09025bd24ec8680354b1c9a489c.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]The Skills Wheel now only shows skills you actually own[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a typo in the "Swap back to Leafblower" message[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]And a few extras:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Loading screens now display a proper loading bar[/p][/*][*][p]The mural painting now ticks objectives as expected[/p][/*][*][p]Roman and Mansion level improvements based on community feedback[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]As always, we’d love to hear what you think. Your feedback helps shape every update! [url="https://discord.gg/VwsJQW3WWu"]Join our Discord[/url] and help us make Leaf Blower Co. even better!  [/p][p][/p][p][i]Until next time, [/i][/p][p][i]The Leaf Blower Team[/i][/p]

notes.title: 🌿The new Leaf Blower Co. demo is here🧹
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Leaf Blowers![/h1]

Boy do we have an update for you. After our previous launch, we listened to your feedback, we took our game back into the shop, and have given it a major tune up. In this new & improved version of Leaf Blower Co. there’s been upgrades across the board, but some of the major ones are:

[list]
[*] 🍀 Three brand new levels available in Freeplay; that’s right, now when you complete a job in your sleepy suburban town, you’ll also unlock the ability to visit some far more exotic locales, with all the new experiences and easter eggs that entails…
[*] 🍀 An overhauled PC interface in the HUB; we wanted to make the player experience smoother, and this was one of the biggest things getting in the way. We hope you like the new system!
[*] 🍀 A significantly improved and updated Rake; no longer will it feel like you’re battling against the simplest tool when gathering leaves - things are as they should be, a symphony of tidying cooperation.
[*] 🍀 A big leap forward in terms of performance gains on lower end (And even mid and high range honestly!) PCs. While for now this has all been focussed on smoothing gameplay and polishing existing features, we’re hopeful that these gains in the future will allow us to really push our game forwards for new and exciting gameplay loops!
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3720140/Leaf_Blower_Co_Demo/

As always, thanks for joining us on this journey. We value and need your feedback, so if you have any thoughts for further additions and improvements, [b]please fill out that survey[/b] and let us know!

And of course, if you love all the new stuff we’ve put in the Demo as much as we do, please do think about leaving us a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3720140/#app_reviews_hash]Steam Review[/url]. At these early stages it makes all the difference, both to us as Developers and to help new players find our game.

[url=https://discord.gg/vpqqamaEbJ]Join our Discord[/url] and help us make Leaf Blower Co. even better!

[i]Until next time,
The Leaf Blower Team[/i]

notes.title: Leaf Blower Co. Demo - Going But Not Forever
notes.content:
[h3]Hello fellow Leaf Blowers![/h3]

Some big news here. [b]We've heard your feedback, and while we're ecstatic that so many of you love the game already and can't wait to play more, we also know that we've still got work to do.[/b]

The Demo's not where it needs to be to make the game really shine, and we know we can get it there with a bit more hard work. So [b]we're going to be taking it down soon[/b], to give it the love and polish it needs, and then get it back to you guys as a much better and stronger Leaf Blower Co.

Thank you to everyone who's already played and given us your valuable time and thoughts for improvements, we appreciate every single one of you. And if you haven't given it a go yet, this weekend may be your last chance for a little while, so why not give it a go! You really can help shape the game's development for the months to come.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3720140/Leaf_Blower_Co_Demo/
In the mean-time, keep being your relaxed chilled-out selves, and we'll be back as soon as we can, like leaves on the wind.🍂

[i]– The Forklift Interactive Team[/i]

notes.title: 🌿Leaf Blower Co. Demo is Out Now! 🧹
notes.content:
[h1]🍂 Leaf Blower Co. Demo is Live! Start Your Career Today![/h1]

Grab your blower, take on your first jobs, and see what it’s like to start a leaf-clearing business in a peaceful New England town. Whether you're raking in the sunshine or blowing away leaves during a blizzard, we hope it’s the chill sim experience you’ve been waiting for.

[previewyoutube=RrjsI8e-nFw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]☀️ What’s in the Demo?[/h2]
[list]
[*] Three full story jobs to complete;
[*] Optional objectives and secrets in each level;
[*] Unlockable tools like the Shredder and Weed Burner;
[*] Skills to level up and use like the Scanner and Magnet;
[*] Freeplay mode with customizable time of day and weather;
[*] Hats, skins, and XP progression!
[/list]

All this and it’s just a taste of what’s coming in the full game later this year, which will include a whopping 30 levels and a growing toolset to unlock!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3720140/Leaf_Blower_Co_Demo

[h2]💬 We’d love to hear what you think[/h2]

If you enjoyed the demo, please consider [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3720140/#app_reviews_hash]leaving a review[/url] on the Demo Page. It means a lot to us, especially during these first few days when every bit of support makes a real difference.

🧤 You’ll also find a [b]feedback form[/b] right inside the game. We read every message you send. Your thoughts help us fix what is not working, build on what is, and shape Leaf Blower Co. into the best version it can be.

That’s just the beginning! [url=https://discord.gg/vpqqamaEbJ]Join our Discord[/url] and help us make Leaf Blower Co. even better!

notes.title: 🍃 Welcome to Leaf Blower Co. – now on Steam!
notes.content:
[h3]Hey there, and welcome![/h3]

We just launched [b]the official Steam page[/b] for Leaf Blower Co., and we’re so happy to have you here. It’s our very first post — and the start of this cozy, leaf-filled journey together 🌿

If you’d like to try the game early, you can now [b]sign up for the Playtest[/b] directly on the store page. We’re letting in new players every day, and your feedback will help us shape what’s next.

🗓 [b]The public Demo lands May 22![/b]

[previewyoutube=EdZQQ7xBkh8;full][/previewyoutube]

The demo includes three full story jobs, unlockable tools and skills, and a customizable Freeplay mode where you can choose the level, weather, and time of day. Whether you’ve got 15 minutes or an hour to relax, we hope you’ll find something satisfying in the art of clearing leaves.

Made by the team at [b]LifT Games[/b] and published by [b]Forklift Interactive[/b], Leaf Blower Co. is all about chill vibes, simple tools, and making a mess look good again.

🧡 Follow the game, join our Discord, and let us know what you think — we’re just getting started, and it means the world to have you along for the ride.

👉 [url=https://discord.gg/vpqqamaEbJ]Join the Discord[/url]

Thanks for stopping by, and see you in the leaves!

[i]– The Forklift Interactive Team[/i]
